QuestInfo.1: Although she gave you a bit more of a response than the adults of the town, #p2152009# still seems to distance herself from you. You try to think of ways to befriend #p2152009#... Perhaps you can give #p2152009# a gift. After all, she seems to be in search of #bFruits to give her big sister#k.

According to #p2152009#, the residents of this town hate anyone who is a part of the #p1101000# Knights. You can't imagine what the #p1101000# Knights have done to the townspeople...
